facts.fact: Efficacy News reports the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act No. 4 of 2021 as the existing law giving a legal framework for electronic transactions and secure electronic signatures, now under consultation for amendment; no commencement date is given, so the as_of is the Act's year.
facts.system: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act No. 4 of 2021

facts.fact: The Ministry of Technology and Science began stakeholder consultations on amendments to the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act, which Cabinet approved in principle in September 2025; the meeting is reported on 30 September 2026 (date read from the publication day).
facts.system: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act No. 4 of 2021

facts.fact: ZICTA was designated National Root Certification Authority under the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act; the article gives no date for the designation, so the as_of is the article's published date.
facts.system: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act No. 4 of 2021

systems.owner: ZICTA as National Root Certification Authority
